events.note: 決着の時 (scene 124, Brad's route, Independence Army and OZ): its end event sets var21 = 2 and registers Kurtz with Virose (3D5A 31,0,35,500) when Brad has 100 kills. Then Super Earthgain @super is built for our roster (data/new_units.json combine: Earthgain 34 leading, Virose 35; the host builds the instance when the event starts, its crew Brad and Kurtz, its levels from 34). It deploys combined; on the map 分離 gives Earthgain and Virose back (招雷 天竜魔滅陣 between them), and Earthgain's 合体 next to Virose, neither acted, makes Super Earthgain again.

title.ja: スーパーアースゲイン

text.ja: カーツが仲間になれば、アースゲインとヴァイローズが合体したスーパーアースゲインで出撃。マップ上で分離・合体できる
text.zh-Hans: 卡茨入队后，夺地者与瓦伊罗斯合体为超级夺地者出击，地图上可以分离、再合体
text.zh-Hant: 卡茨入隊後，奪地者與瓦伊羅斯合體為超級奪地者出擊，地圖上可以分離、再合體
text.en: When Kurtz joins, Earthgain and Virose combine into Super Earthgain and deploy as one; on the map they can separate and combine again
text.ko: 카츠가 동료가 되면 어스게인과 바이로즈가 합체한 슈퍼 어스게인으로 출격. 맵에서 분리·합체할 수 있다
